findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 32 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 78 questions numbered 1-78; by section: 32.1 12, 32.2 3, 32.3 13, 32.4 5, 32.5 8, 32.6 5, 32.7 7, 32.8 4, 32.9 3, 32.10 4, 32.11 2, 32.12 6, 32.13 3, 32.14 3.

Covers sections 32.1-32.14 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; TI values and acid-rain mole ratios were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise (its window/index, penicillin inhibition, opiate analgesia, antiviral challenge, pesticide resistance, chlor-alkali naming and hazard items are avoided). Book corrections followed: TI = TD₅₀/ED₅₀, penicillin mimics the enzyme's substrate, polyprotein cutting by protease, nickel as a micronutrient, zinc phosphide a rodenticide.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
